summary.name: Audiotools
summary.one_liner: A set of audio testing tools (signal generator, oscilloscope, and level measuring sets) for Windows, Linux, Mac, or Android devices.
use_cases: Viewing audio waveforms on a scope-style display
Measuring relative audio level at a selected frequency
Checking frequency response of an audio system
summary.what_it_does: Audiotools bundles several audio test instruments. The Signal Generator outputs sine, square, and sawtooth waveforms from 10Hz to 25kHz at levels from 0dB to -80dB, with keyboard and mouse frequency control and an exact-frequency entry option. The Oscilloscope offers timebases from 0.1ms to 0.5sec, adjustable sync level, single-shot and storage modes, and a cursor for reading time and value. The LMS (Level Measuring Set) measures frequency and relative level with a spectrum display using the selected audio input. The SLMS (Selective Level Measuring Set) measures relative level at a chosen frequency with a spectrum display. The page states that absolute level measurement is not possible due to variables in the sound system.
notable: Signal generator with sine, square and sawtooth waveforms and keyboard frequency control
Oscilloscope with single-shot, storage and adjustable sync level
Level measuring sets show relative level only, not absolute
caveats: Absolute level measurement is not possible; only relative levels are shown
Oscilloscope has no calibration due to varying audio system level controls
